1.0.0.en: Updated icons and initial release on Homey v12.

1.0.3.en: Added support for new AC and TV remote drivers and updated flow cards to use them.

1.0.4.en: Change method to find model traits for AC and TV devices.

1.0.5.en: Fixed localhost setting in MQTT broker configuration so it doesn't need the mqtt:// prefix. Fixed closedown of internal broker when changing settings so it can restart correctly.

1.0.6.en: Fixed crash when trying to start internal MQTT broker if the configured port is already in use. Added error handling and logging for this case, and added a warning message in the settings UI to explain the issue.
